headlines.text: 2024 brought us this moment: Quen stepped through the curtain for the first time, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.80.

2023 brought us this moment: Rey Fenix vs. Nick Jackson fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.71 ? a well-worked match. For Nick Jackson, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Toni Storm vs. Skye Blue headlined Dynamite, rated 6.24 in a standout Women's division showcase ? part of that year's Anniversary Show '23.
It was 2024 when The Learning Tree (Bill & Keith) didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.84.
